title: X (Twitter) Ads Scraper & Competitor Monitor
description: Public EU-served X advertising transparency. Fields not disclosed are null with provenance; global ad-content discovery is unavailable.

advertisers.title: Advertiser handles or IDs
advertisers.description: Accounts to inspect. Accepts handles, @handles, public x.com/twitter.com profile URLs, and numeric user IDs. Maximum 200. This source does not support global content search.
advertisers.sectionDescription: X discloses ads served in supported EU markets. Enter advertiser accounts first.

countries.title: Countries where ads were served
countries.description: ISO alpha-2 served-country codes. Validated against live supported countries. UK/EEA coverage is not assumed. Ignored for a named market preset.

marketPreset.title: Market preset
marketPreset.description: Expand a region to supported served countries. Unsupported members such as CH or GB are skipped with a warning.

startDate.title: Delivery period starts
startDate.description: UTC day or relative date (e.g. 90 days). Clamped to the source minimum. Defaults to the last 90 days.

endDate.title: Delivery period ends
endDate.description: Inclusive UTC day or relative date. 0 days means today. Future dates clamp to today.

keywords.title: Include keywords or phrases
keywords.description: Match words, quoted phrases, or /RE2 regex/. Runs after enrichment when server-side search is unavailable.
keywords.sectionDescription: Unknown fields are kept with filterUncertain unless strict filtering is enabled. Exclusions always win.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords or phrases
excludeKeywords.description: Drop known matches before positive keyword matching. Supports quoted phrases and /regex/.

keywordMatch.title: Keyword match rule
keywordMatch.description: Any matches at least one include expression; all requires every include expression.

keywordFields.title: Fields searched by keywords
keywordFields.description: Creative text, advertiser identity, disclosed targeting and landing URL. Selecting creativeText automatically enables creative enrichment.

caseSensitive.title: Match case exactly
caseSensitive.description: When off, Unicode compatibility/diacritic folding and case folding support European-language matching.

targetedLocations.title: Disclosed geo-targeting
targetedLocations.description: Strings matched against disclosed target locations, distinct from the country where the ad was served.

minImpressions.title: Minimum impressions
minImpressions.description: Keep rows with at least this many disclosed impressions.

minReach.title: Minimum unique reach
minReach.description: Keep rows with at least this disclosed reach. Unique reach cannot be summed across chunks.

approvalStatuses.title: Approval statuses
approvalStatuses.description: Free text, compared without case. Suggested source values include Verified and Halted; new values remain usable.

fundingTypes.title: Funding instrument types
fundingTypes.description: Free-text disclosed funding types, compared without case. No payment-person lookup is performed.

mediaTypes.title: Creative media types
mediaTypes.description: Experimental media metadata must be disclosed by repository/embed/API. Unknown is not treated as text.

strictFilters.title: Drop rows with unknown filtered fields
strictFilters.description: When on, unavailable fields cannot satisfy a filter. When off, undecidable matches are kept with filterUncertain=true.

enrichCreatives.title: Enrich public post text
enrichCreatives.description: Fetch public oEmbed text, author and links per unique tweet ID. Deleted/protected posts retain repository metrics.

resolveLandingUrls.title: Resolve landing URLs
resolveLandingUrls.description: Follow disclosed t.co links with bounded redirects, strict timeouts and public-destination checks; extract domain and UTM fields.

lookupMedia.title: Experimental media lookup
lookupMedia.description: Best-effort asset details through official X API v2 with a supplied token, otherwise public embed metadata. Failures never remove repository metrics.

xBearerToken.title: X developer bearer token
xBearerToken.description: Optional permitted developer app bearer token. Required for direct documented export mode and official API media lookups. Never logged.

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: Snapshot emits matching ads without reading/writing monitor state. Monitor emits only NEW, CHANGED and REMOVED.

monitorKey.title: Monitor identity
monitorKey.description: Optional stable label hashed for state keys. Otherwise derived from advertiser/country/filter inputs. Keep the same value in your scheduled task.

monitorStoreName.title: Named monitor state store
monitorStoreName.description: Persistent named Apify KVS. State is sharded by advertiser, country and ad-key bucket. Schedule overlapping runs sequentially.

notifyOn.title: Notify on these events
notifyOn.description: One digest per run for selected material campaign events.

removalGraceRuns.title: Complete runs before removal
removalGraceRuns.description: Absent campaigns are removed only after this many fully successful runs of the same scope. Partial/failed queries never increment absence.

metricChangeThresholdPercent.title: Metric-change threshold (%)
metricChangeThresholdPercent.description: Null means impression/reach growth alone is not a material change. Set a percentage to include significant changes relative to the previous observation.

webhookUrl.title: Generic webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS digest endpoint. Gets full emitted-event JSON and X-X-Ads-Signature: sha256=<HMAC>.

webhookSecret.title: Webhook HMAC secret
webhookSecret.description: Required with webhookUrl. HMAC-SHA256 signs the exact UTF-8 request body.

slackWebhookUrl.title: Slack incoming webhook URL
slackWebhookUrl.description: Optional Slack incoming webhook endpoint. Gets native Block Kit digest formatting.

discordWebhookUrl.title: Discord webhook URL
discordWebhookUrl.description: Optional Discord endpoint. Gets a native embed digest.

notifyMaxItems.title: Maximum ads in channel digest
notifyMaxItems.description: Limit displayed top ads in Slack/Discord and generic highlights. Generic full events remain available in the linked dataset.

notifyOnEmpty.title: Send an empty digest
notifyOnEmpty.description: Send a summary even when no selected campaign event was emitted.

exportFormats.title: Generate download files
exportFormats.description: Files in the run KVS: BOM CSV, JSON, streaming Excel, and self-contained HTML. Native dataset export is always available.

includeRaw.title: Include original source rows
includeRaw.description: Keep raw repository rows for auditing. Increases storage/export sizes.

sortBy.title: Result order
sortBy.description: Sort final emitted results on disk. Unknown metrics sort last.

maxAdsPerAdvertiser.title: Maximum emitted ads per advertiser
maxAdsPerAdvertiser.description: Null means no output cap. A cap never justifies removal inference; un-emitted new/change events remain pending for the next run.

maxItems.title: Maximum emitted ads overall
maxItems.description: Null means no output cap. A cap never justifies removal inference; un-emitted new/change events remain pending for the next run.

sourceMode.title: Source adapter
sourceMode.description: Auto probes the best verified working source. API is a documented stub until a new official API is verified; export needs a permitted bearer token.

enablePublicUiTransport.title: Enable public UI HTTP service
enablePublicUiTransport.description: Feature flag for anonymous endpoints discovered in current public-page assets. They are not a documented API. Logs a warning and falls back to anonymous browser/export if unavailable.

concurrency.title: Concurrent source queries
concurrency.description: Polite default is two jobs. Lower to one when the source is slow or rate limited.

requestDelayMs.title: Minimum request spacing per host (ms)
requestDelayMs.description: Token-bucket host pacing shared by repository, enrichment and notifications.

maxRetries.title: Maximum request retries
maxRetries.description: Bounded retries with exponential backoff/jitter for retryable errors. Auth/invalid queries do not retry.

jobTimeoutMinutes.title: Export job timeout (minutes)
jobTimeoutMinutes.description: Maximum time for a submitted CSV job; polling is capped near 15 seconds. Export IDs are checkpointed.

maxExportJobs.title: Maximum planned source jobs
maxExportJobs.description: Fail before submission if advertiser × country × date chunks exceeds this number.

operationIds.title: Advanced export operation IDs
operationIds.description: Optional create/status IDs from a permitted current public-page network capture. Never credentials. Normally discovered from live page assets.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default. Configure Apify datacenter proxies as the first escalation for permitted access. No identity cycling or CAPTCHA bypass.
